critical_findings.title: Docker builder toolchain drift: golang:1.25-alpine vs go.mod go 1.26
critical_findings.fix: Pin FROM golang:1.26-alpine (digest-pinned ideally); decide whether the image ships at all since goreleaser releases bare binaries only

critical_findings.title: auth rotate is a shipped placeholder that always errors; --revoke-old would revoke the NEW token
critical_findings.fix: Implement rotation via Cloudflare API Token endpoints or remove the subcommand; capture oldToken before overwriting profile.APIToken (cmd/auth.go:227-239)

critical_findings.title: .dockerignore incomplete: COPY . . sends ~1.4GB build context (desktop/node_modules, 105MB stale binaries)
critical_findings.fix: Exclude desktop/, GOrchestra/, r2go2*, cmd.test, *-setup, ClaudeDesktop/, ClaudeDesign/, plugins/; dedupe duplicate entries

critical_findings.title: Dead CI workflows encode a divergent, untested release path with no security scanning
critical_findings.fix: Delete workflows (CI permanently disabled by policy) or reduce to notes-only; add govulncheck to make release-prepare so the live pipeline has a vulnerability gate

critical_findings.title: Tauri desktop webview has no Content-Security-Policy (csp: null)
critical_findings.fix: Set explicit CSP: default-src 'self'; connect-src 'self' http://127.0.0.1:*; img-src 'self' data:

critical_findings.title: Non-constant-time daemon token comparison
critical_findings.fix: Use subtle.ConstantTimeCompare for the bearer and query token checks

critical_findings.title: API token prompted with terminal echo; flags leak to shell history/ps
critical_findings.fix: Use golang.org/x/term.ReadPassword for silent input; document env-var as the history-safe path

critical_findings.title: 93 committed transcripts + GOrchestra artifacts make the secret scanner 538-finding noise
critical_findings.fix: Move transcripts/agent logs out of the tracked tree; allowlist AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE (AWS docs placeholder) in scanner config

critical_findings.title: Stale r2go2 identity across Dockerfile, Makefile, SECURITY.md (dead repo URL CosmoDev-R2Go2)
critical_findings.fix: Rename sweep to cosmoflare; fix SECURITY.md URLs and binary names

critical_findings.title: Terraform export provider version default stale (~> 4.0 vs provider 5.x)
critical_findings.fix: Default to ~> 5.0, matching the command's own help example

critical_findings.title: Plaintext secrets fallback when OS keychain unavailable (no warning)
critical_findings.fix: Print one-time warning on auth login when storing unencrypted to config.yaml

critical_findings.title: Raw cmd.Start() in installer TUI violates project spawn policy (ROAD-525)
critical_findings.fix: Use cmd.Run() in a goroutine or daemon.SpawnAsync()

recommendations.action: Decide the Docker story: publish a scanned multi-arch image via goreleaser docker section, or delete the container surface
Add govulncheck (and optionally gosec) to make release-prepare — the only pipeline that runs
Implement real auth rotate via Cloudflare API and fix the revoke-old token ordering bug
Dockerfile hygiene: golang:1.26-alpine, pinned alpine, -o cosmoflare, HEALTHCHECK, extended .dockerignore
Delete or neuter dead workflow files; leave a policy pointer
Set Tauri CSP; constant-time token compare; silent token prompt

roadmap_suggestions.title: Release supply-chain hardening
roadmap_suggestions.description: cosign-sign release assets, govulncheck gate in release-prepare, scanner allowlist for AWS docs placeholders so real findings surface

roadmap_suggestions.title: Real credential lifecycle
roadmap_suggestions.description: Implement auth rotate/revoke against the Cloudflare API Tokens API with expiry warnings in auth status

roadmap_suggestions.title: Container image or bust
roadmap_suggestions.description: Either publish a maintained multi-arch image via goreleaser with trivy scanning and digest pinning, or remove the Dockerfile and Makefile docker targets entirely

roadmap_suggestions.title: Repo de-noising
roadmap_suggestions.description: Move conversation transcripts and GOrchestra agent artifacts out of the tracked tree; coordinate with history-purge constraints
